/            Filter Mode
?            Help
Ctrl-R       Refresh
Ctrl-S       Save
Ctrl-Space   Mark Range
Ctrl-W       Toggle Wide
Ctrl-Z       Toggle Faults
Ctrl-\       Marks Clear
Enter        View
Esc          Filter Reset
Shift-A      Sort Age
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-S      Sort Status
c            Copy
d            Describe
key-272      Help
q            Filter Reset
space        Mark
y            YAML
